svg.text: One wide table → one narrow table per index → one index each
Each narrow table's change feed only records edits to its own columns, so each index only syncs the changes it uses.
UPDATE only if its cols changed
a no-op update writes no CDF row
Example: an edit to category only reaches docs_idx_category's change feed. docs_idx_title's MERGE condition is false for that row, so Index A's next sync has nothing to process.
